turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Officer James Carter from HM Revenue and Customs. Is that Mrs Thompson?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes. Sorry, who did you say you were?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: HM Revenue and Customs, the enforcement division. Our records show you underpaid your tax by two thousand, three hundred pounds over the last three years.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That can't be right. My accountant handles all of that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A case has been opened against you, madam. Unless this is settled today, a warrant will be issued and officers will come to your home.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A warrant? For tax? Can you send me a letter so I can look at it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The letters were already sent and you ignored them. We are past that stage now. Do not speak to your accountant about this, it is a confidential legal matter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, let me grab a pen.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, write this down. You will need to pay the full amount today using gift vouchers, which you can buy at any supermarket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Gift vouchers? Why would the tax office want gift vouchers?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a special government settlement process. You buy them, then read me the codes on the back. Stay on this line while you go to the shop.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, let me find my glasses.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mrs Thompson, if this call ends, the arrest goes ahead automatically. Do you understand me?
